title: He–et al. complete multipartite chromatic-choosability conjecture
statement: A **complete $k$-partite graph** is a graph whose vertices are partitioned into $k$ independent parts, with every pair of vertices in distinct parts adjacent. **He et al.'s conjecture.** Any complete $k$-partite graph $G$ with $n(G)=2k+1$ is chromatic-choosable. This is presented as a complete-multipartite reformulation of Ohba's conjecture and is therefore resolved by the same result.
source_name: Nandana K Vasudevan, K Somasundaram and N Narayanan, “List-Coloring and Chromatic-Choosability – A Dynamic Survey”, arXiv:2606.31702 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.31702
